name: Komakage
parentage: Selected from a native Zairai population.
description: An excellent shading cultivar from Aichi prefecture, known for its strong, upright growth and resistance to cold. It produces a high-quality Tencha for Matcha with a good balance of umami and a unique, slightly savory, almost spicy character that distinguishes it from the classic Uji cultivars.
plantType: Vigorous, upright bush with strong cold resistance (Camellia sinensis var. sinensis).
environment: Very well-suited to the climate of Aichi and other regions that experience colder winters than southern Japan.
processing: Komakage is well-suited for shaded cultivation. Its robust nature makes it a reliable choice for farmers. It is processed into Tencha for Matcha production.
oxidation: Zero oxidation. The leaves are steamed promptly after being harvested from the shaded plants.
roasting: No roasting. As Tencha, the leaves are dried flat in a special oven without being rolled to prepare them for stone-milling.
versatility: Highly specialized for Matcha. It is a key cultivar for Matcha production outside of the Uji region, particularly in Aichi.

Matcha & Tencha.Nishio Matcha: It is a cornerstone cultivar for Matcha from the Nishio region, prized for its unique flavor profile and reliability.

sensory.flavor: Good umami with a unique, slightly spicy or savory character and a clean finish.
sensory.mouthfeel_liquor: Smooth and full-bodied, creating a satisfying bowl of Matcha. The liquor is a deep, strong green.
